name: Xiaomi TV
description: Turn the Xiaomi TV on or off and switch its HDMI input from anywhere on the house LAN — Home Assistant, a dashboard, a phone, an agent. No remote and no IR blaster: it talks to the TV over the network and reads the TV's own power state back, so a switch that says "on" means the screen really is on.

tv_host.description: TV's LAN address. Give it a DHCP reservation — this app finds the TV by IP, so a new lease silently breaks every call.

tv_port.description: TCP port the TV listens for network debugging on. 5555 unless you changed it on the TV.

adb_path.description: Path to the adb binary. Leave as "adb" to use the one this app installs.

default_input.description: Input to switch to when the TV is turned on.

inputs.description: Maps each input name to the TV's own internal id for that socket. The defaults are right for this Xiaomi model; only change them if an input switches to the wrong socket.
